title: UFO: Unfair-to-Fair Evolving Mitigates Unfairness in LLM-based Recommender Systems via Self-Play Fine-tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Ranking items by their interaction counts, dividing them into five equally sized groups, and comparing their recommendation distribution against historical interaction proportions using Mean Group Unfairness (MGU) and Disparity Group Unfairness (DGU) metrics.
Assigning items to groups based on their extracted genres and comparing the proportion of recommended items in each genre group to their historical interaction proportions using MGU and DGU.

Ranking items by the length of their titles, dividing them into five equally sized groups, and measuring the deviation of their recommendation ratios from historical interaction ratios using MGU and DGU.
